name: Afonso Ribeiro
bio:
Afonso's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing, fueled by his grandfather's stories of navigating treacherous Portuguese roads. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, but quickly realized his passion lay in the organizational and strategic aspects of race teams. After a brief stint as a data analyst for a Formula 4 team, he transitioned into operations, hungry to learn the intricacies of team management.

Afonso approaches his role with a blend of meticulous planning and adaptability. He believes in empowering team members and fostering a collaborative environment where innovation can flourish. His calm demeanor under pressure, coupled with a knack for identifying bottlenecks, makes him a valuable asset in the high-stakes world of racing. He is determined to build a legacy of operational excellence.

What sets Afonso apart is his ability to see the big picture while remaining grounded in the details. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and is constantly seeking new ways to optimize team performance, driven by a firm belief in the power of data-driven decision-making.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Afonso has a serious expression and a wiry build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even during races.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Portuguese coffee before every race.
